services.desc: Rates - 1 person $495 - 2nd person can be added for additional $200 - Max amount of riders: 2 Duration 3 Hour About Go fo a Foiling DownWinder and feel the magic of endless foiling on bay/ocean swells! When you don't use any wind instruments such as kite or wing and have only the foil and your swell reading skills to rely on, it's a luring challenge to see how far you can fly! Whether you choose to SUP paddle or get towed up by the Windseeker Support Boat, you will have the opportunity to work on your riding/pumping technique and heighten your bump-hunting skills. Depending on conditions, there can be various zones where the swell/bumps are good. We can find the best spot for the day. 2

services.name: Beginner's Intro to Kitesurfing
services.desc: Welcome the sport of kitesurfing! There are two components: Kite-flying/Board riding. You need to do both well seperately before you are able to do both simultaneously. This course focuses on the kite and getting your initial body-dragging experience entering the water with a kite. It’s a full size-kite you’ll be flying in the first lesson, and you''ll get a chance to get up on the board on the first lesson! This course will help you build kite-flying skills that are safe and effective habits for future progression. 3hr course, 1 day Participants must weight between 110 -

services.name: Intermediate Kitesurfing
services.desc: If you have some experience and want to start spending more time up on the water riding on the board (rather than in the water) then this is course for you. You will spend the majority of the session in the water with the kite hooked up and the board on your feet trying to extend your riding time. You might find it helpful to start with a little board riding riding using the KitePole. Board Skills Video This is a great refresher course for those that had a previous lesson and are eager to get in the water and get going again. 3hr course, 1 day Participants must weight between 110 -

services.name: Advanced Kitesurfing
services.desc: This course is for riders who are looking to add the final touches to their techinque. Although you are spending most of the time up and riding on the water, you still aren't ready to go out on your own. Many riders use this course as a confidence builder, knowing boat support is there for them as they discover the freedom to ride long distances. Upwind riding is a focus point. 3hr course, 1 day Participants must weight between 110 -

services.name: Board Skills Training
services.desc: Board skills can be difficult to master, especially when you’re trying to fly a kite at the same time! Being “hooked-in” and pulled with your harness is awkward at first. This session with the “KitePole” will give you the opportunity to get comfortable with this connection and develop board handling skills. Getting up and riding on the board is the main goal, but other helpful things like putting you on your feet and body-dragging are also practiced in this session. After this course, you’ll be more prepared to take on the responsibility of flying a kite while keeping the board positioned properly on you feet. 2hr course, 1 day Participants must weight between 110 -

services.name: Foil Kitesurfing
services.desc: Learning how to ride the Foil Board begins with understanding what’s happening underneath the board and learning to control it. It’s an airplane underneath you which requires a new way of balance, different from twin-tip or surfboard riding. With the lack of water drag, it’s possible to slip into new points of sail and discover a new freedom of movement that enable you to point super high, go fast, and be so smooth! This session begins by getting towed behind the boat so you are able to focus only on the foilboard and how to balance on it; no kite handling is involved in this first stage. services.name: Golden Gate Expeditions
services.desc: Got a taste for adventure? A need for challenge? Come kite the bay and discover the beauty and magnificence of the San Francisco Bay. Ride under the Golden Gate bridge, cruise past the San Francisco cityfront and up close to Alcatraz Island, aka “the rock”. Experience the variable conditions of the bay and put your abilities to the test. Having the boat support of the Windseeker, there’s opportunity to stop, rest and even change gear along the way. We can go the distance if you’re up for it! Truly a journey of a lifetime! Being in such a windy area, the San Francisco Bay possesses a variety of kitesurfing areas. services.name: Foil Surfing
services.desc: About FoilSurfing is a new watersport combining the magic of a foil and energy of a wave. It's the new craze for both shortboard and SUP surfers alike! But without foiling experience, it can be a long and difficult learning process. Take a Foilsurfing course that will give you the confidence to paddle out in the waves and catch your first foiling ride! services.name: WingFoiling Lessons
services.desc: Welcome the sport of WingFoiling! There are two components: Wing-flying/FoilBoard riding. Wing-Foiling / Wing-surfing / Wing-Boarding has recently emerged as a way to get on the water and enjoy a session holding the wing and riding a foilboard. The simplicity of the gear makes it attractive to new water enthusiasts and also to long-time enthusiasts as a new challenge to take on. With Wing-surfing, there's a potential to get out in waves and ride swells in a downwinder or at proper surf breaks.
